rule: Users: one learner named after the default username and exactly 35 bots; usernames unique and lower-case; avatar colours #RRGGBB; exactly 16 light (4 to 10 XP a day), 13 medium (20 to 45) and 6 heavy (60 to 110) bots.

cases.name: learner-is-not-the-default-user
cases.expect: users.json › learner › username: must be 'alex', the default learner

cases.name: username-with-capitals
cases.expect: users.json: usernames must be lower-case: Kenji_t

cases.name: avatar-colour-not-hex
cases.expect: users.json › bots[0] › avatarColor: String should match pattern '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'

cases.name: pace-classes-unbalanced
cases.expect: users.json: needs exactly 16 light bots, has 15; needs exactly 13 medium bots, has 14

cases.name: daily-xp-outside-the-pace
cases.expect: users.json › bots[2]: a light bot earns 4 to 10 XP a day, not 12
